title: The Miscellaneous & Unknown subscription: a preconfigured profile, an automatic rule and five editable settings
aliases: cannot allow copy paste isolation profile

checks.do: On an existing tenant, whether the automatically created Miscellaneous & Unknown URL Filtering rule was enabled.
Whether a setting the admin wants to change is one of the five editable fields on the preconfigured profile.

limited-tier.statement: Depending on the organization's level of Zero Trust Browser access, admins might be able to isolate only the Miscellaneous & Unknown URL category.

quotes: Depending on your organization's level of Zero Trust Browser access, you might only have the ability to isolate the category Miscellaneous & Unknown.

preconfigured-profile.statement: With the Miscellaneous & Unknown Category subscription, Zero Trust Browser creates a preconfigured isolation profile at first login, different from the default profiles created for other access levels.

quotes: If you have the Miscellaneous & Unknown Category subscription, Zero Trust Browser makes a preconfigured isolation profile for you when you first log in.
This profile is different from the default isolation profiles that are made for different levels of Zero Trust Browser access upon first login.

auto-rule.statement: An Internet & SaaS URL Filtering rule for the Miscellaneous & Unknown category is created automatically; it is disabled by default for existing tenants and enabled by default for new tenants.

quotes: Additionally, an Internet & SaaS URL filtering rule with the category of Miscellaneous & Unknown is automatically created.
The rule is disabled by default for existing tenants, but it is enabled by default for new tenants.

fixed-settings.statement: The preconfigured profile's automatic settings are: name Misc & Unknown; Turbo Mode enabled; the recommended PAC file URL with Override PAC File disabled; Debug Mode disabled; the default Zscaler root certificate; copy and paste, file transfer and print disabled; Read-Only Isolation enabled; viewing office files in isolation, local browser rendering, application deep linking and Votiro CDR disabled; region selection All; the default isolation banner; Persist Browser Isolation URL bar disabled; Native Browser Experience; watermarking disabled; and Persistent State disabled.

quotes: PAC File URL: Use Recommended PAC file URL
Root Certificate: Default Zscaler Root Certificate
View office files in Isolation: Disabled
Persist Browser Isolation URL bar: Disabled

editable-fields.statement: After the profile is created, admins can edit Turbo Mode, Debug Mode, Root Certificate, Read-Only Isolation and Region Selection.

locked-exfiltration.statement: So on this subscription, copy and paste, file transfer and print stay disabled on the preconfigured profile: they are among its automatic settings and not among the five fields admins can edit.
locked-exfiltration.conditions: Follows from the two lists in the Miscellaneous & Unknown article; the article does not say whether Zscaler Support or a subscription change can unlock them.
